payload.title: Pilobol.us P3-01: parity harness (byte diff vs live, narration text hash) and renderer baseline
payload.description:
## Goal
A reusable parity harness so every later step can prove "the site did not change by one byte" and "narrated text did not change": compare two built trees, or a built tree against the live site, byte for byte, plus a per-article hash of the narrated text.

## Context (FACT, verified 2026-10-06)
- Live reader: Amplify app d1od6t7lzbwanr (WEB), branch main, last job 196 at commit 7f30fa9 (Pilobol.us origin/main). It builds web/build_via_papyrus.py with Papyrus pinned at d664fc7 (PAPYRUS_ROOT source import) and anthus-markus 0.5.1 from git.
- Measured today: a scratch clone of Pilobol.us origin/main built with the d664fc7 renderer = 94 files; the same clone built with the Papyrus develop (4a423c3) renderer = identical 94 files; fetching all 94 paths from https://pilobol.us gave 94/94 byte-identical bodies. So today: renderer parity holds and the live site equals a scratch Git build.
- 11 pages carry the Auritus embed (script src https://aurit.us/embed.js): the 10 articles plus a-fungus-among-us.html. Narration is generated in the reader's browser from the rendered page; the job hash covers text + voice + backend. Same bytes means same text.
- The 6 largest files are in assets/ (largest 6,047,745 bytes, assets/he-said-he-could-see-it/gowy-fall-of-icarus.jpg).
- The repo's own build writes into its content dir (front matter author default, index.md, articles/index.md): only ever run it on a scratch copy.

## Exact steps
1. In a worktree of AnthusAI/Pilobol.us (not /Users/home/Projects/Pilobol.us) on branch feature/PPY-<this id>-parity-harness add bin/verify-parity.py (stdlib only):
   - verify-parity.py --a DIR --b DIR : compare file sets and bytes; print only-in-a, only-in-b, differing files (first differing offset); exit 1 on any difference.
   - verify-parity.py --dist DIR --live https://pilobol.us : for every file in DIR GET the same path from the live site (User-Agent set, follow no redirects, require 200) and compare bytes; exit 1 on any difference or non-200.
   - add --narration : for each .html file containing aurit.us/embed.js extract the text of the first element with class markus-document (html.parser) and compare sha256 per file (A vs B, or dist vs live); print one line per page.
   - add --json for machine output (used by build gates in later tickets).
2. Add bin/baseline-build.sh: git clone (or git archive origin/main) into a scratch dir, install anthus-markus==0.5.1 plus the Papyrus renderer from PAPYRUS_ROOT, run web/build_via_papyrus.py there, print the dist path. Never builds in place.
3. Record the baseline (numbers above) in this ticket.

## Acceptance checks
- baseline-build.sh then verify-parity.py --dist <scratch dist> --live https://pilobol.us reports 94/94 identical and 11/11 narration hashes equal.
- Pin build vs develop-renderer build: verify-parity.py --a ... --b ... exits 0.
- Negative test: change one character in one scratch article: exit 1 naming the file and the narration page.
- No writes outside the scratch dir.

## Rollback
Delete the branch (nothing live is touched).

## Risks
- Live fetches go through CloudFront: a deploy in progress can mix old and new files. Re-run on mismatch before concluding.
- The generated sitemap.xml and robots.txt must also match (they are in the 94).

## Needs Ryan
Nothing.

## Common rules (apply to every Phase 3 Pilobol.us ticket)
- Plan: docs/migrations/pilobol-us.md (AnthusAI/Papyrus, PR from branch docs/PPY-3367d3-pilobol-us-migration-plan). Facts there were verified 2026-10-06; marked FACT or ASSUMPTION. Re-verify anything you depend on before acting.
- LIVE steps (marked LIVE) touch production resources (apps d1od6t7lzbwanr and d11eu9hbs2mipk, their branches, domains, stack amplify-app-shell-pilobol-us, the CMS backend). Do them ONLY after Ryan's explicit yes in chat for that step. Everything else is read-only AWS (list/get/describe) or scratch work.
- Read AGENTS.local.md first. AWS_PROFILE=legacy, region us-east-1 (SSO login is Ryan's). Never print an env var or secret VALUE (names only; the apps hold secrets in env vars and SSM). Never run ampx pipeline-deploy locally (Amplify builds do that).
- The local checkout /Users/home/Projects/Pilobol.us is read-only for us, and its build REWRITES content front matter and generated files: never build there. Build only in scratch copies of a fresh clone (git clone https://github.com/AnthusAI/Pilobol.us, or git archive origin/main).
- Papyrus repo work: worktree of origin/develop under /Users/home/Projects/Papyrus-worktrees/, branch feature/PPY-<id>-<slug> (or chore/ for docs), PR into develop, never merge to main, never git stash, conventional commits, commit trailer Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>, PR body ends with the Claude Code generated-with line. Pilobol.us repo work: a feature branch and a PR; never push or merge to its main (production reader deploys from main). In /Users/home/Projects/Papyrus run only kbs; never git add or commit there. Tickets live on the PPY board; do not use kbs in the Pilobol.us repo (PILO board is stories only).
- Keep article text byte-identical everywhere. Narration (Auritus) hashes cover article text: any text change re-queues Batch jobs.
- Update this ticket with branch, PR link, command output and numbers when done.
